topic.readerProblem: A founder or small-business marketer wants to know what Quattr costs and whether an enterprise AI-search platform is worth a demo, without a published price list.
topic.connection: Helps AEOeye readers decide between a free baseline audit, one-off reports, public-price trackers and a sales-led platform, and points them to AEOeye's free audit as the first step.

assessment: The page states in its first lines that Quattr's price is custom and quote-only, lists exactly what quattr.com, Capterra and GetApp show as of 2026-10-03, flags that the only '$99/month' on Quattr's comparison page sits in the Profound column, and removes the unverifiable $79/$249/$599 tiers an earlier version repeated. It explains what plausibly drives a quote (labelled as questions to ask, not a rate card), gives a clear small-business fit position with first-hand AEOeye data and caveats, and offers cheaper paths with a verified public competitor price. It deliberately does not quote G2 reviewer text (G2 blocks automated fetches), state any Quattr price, or claim hands-on testing.

sources.supports: Pricing page lists no price or plan; demo form 'Personalized to your site. 30 seconds to book', ticks 'No credit card', '30-min call', 'Free trial included'; 4.9/5 from 65 G2 reviews; company-size options from 1-50 employees; 'Every customer works with a Quattr Strategist'.

Quattr pricing described as 'Custom pricing (based on your use cases; just pay for features you actually use)'; 'Starts at $99/month for SMBs' is in the Profound column (confirmed in raw table HTML); FAQ trial options (demo, sandbox, free trial, proof of concept, paid pilot); multi-domain, large keyword sets, governance, Growth Concierge; WordPress native publishing 'now'.

March 2026 press release describing Quattr as built for 'mid-market and enterprise brands' and G2 Spring 2026 recognition including High Performer in Content Creation across Enterprise, Mid-Market and Small-Business segments.

Engines named (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Overviews), 'You control what goes live', GIGA agent, reversible and sampled internal linking, CMS drafts, Search Console/GA4 joins, named results (Kiteworks +79% AI Overview presence, CloudEagle 3x AI citation share), no price shown.

Capterra listing shows 'Contact vendor for pricing', free trial available, and typical users 'Freelancers, Small businesses, Mid size businesses, Enterprises' (via WebFetch; Capterra returns 403 to curl, so raw text could not be re-checked).
GetApp pricing section shows 'No pricing info' beside 'Starting from' (via WebFetch; raw text blocked to curl).
Quattr's free AI SEO tools are a Title Generator, H1 Heading Generator, SEO-Friendly URL Generator and Meta Description Generator (confirmed in raw HTML).

Lite plan $29/month, 15 search prompts, 4 AI engines (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, MS Copilot), daily tracking; Claude, Google AI Mode and Gemini are extra add-ons (confirmed in raw HTML).

Google: no additional requirements or special optimizations for AI Overviews and AI Mode, no new machine-readable files or markup needed; AI-feature traffic is included in Search Console's overall search traffic (confirmed in raw HTML).
Wikipedia defines generative engine optimization as the practice of improving visibility in responses generated by generative AI systems (confirmed in raw HTML).

pricing.region: Global / USD references only for third-party comparison
pricing.billing: Quattr: custom quote after demo, billing terms not published; Otterly Lite compared at $29 per month on monthly billing
pricing.verification: Fetched quattr.com/pricing, the homepage and the Quattr vs Profound page (WebFetch plus raw HTML via curl) and found no Quattr price anywhere; Capterra and GetApp show no number; confirmed in the raw table that '$99/month for SMBs' belongs to the Profound column; dropped earlier $79/$249/$599 and '$99' claims that no current source supports; re-read Otterly's raw pricing HTML for the $29 Lite figure.
